name: Harukaze Meguri
source:
[b]An Angel Descending to the Earth, a Fairy Dancing in the Spring Breeze[/b]

Grade: Third-year/internal student, women's basketball club​ member

A [i]senpai[/i] whom [url=/c128223]Kanata[/url] falls in love with at first sight. She is the current ace of the women's basketball team and the object of admiration for [url=/c125790]Kokoro[/url]. Due to her looks and a cheerful personality, she captivates not only the boys, but the girls as well. She kindly evades the boys' invitations, but is not in any way used to it, since she grows up in an all-girls school. She has a younger sister who is the student council president. Meguri herself is a [i]siscon[/i], and always secretly protecting her sister.

"Oh, it's the Dogeza-kun from this morning."

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1232470]Getchu[/url]]
